name: portal_g_mysterious
description: An old woman's voice, low and dry, warm, slightly hoarse, slow and calm, telling a folktale to a child by a fire. Soft northern English accent, from rural Yorkshire. Mysterious and hushed, as if she speaks from somewhere very old and far away, with long thoughtful pauses, gentle and a little sad.
reference_text: Listen, little one. Do you hear the wind in the stones? It remembers. Long ago, people kept a fire beside me, and I kept the night from their door. Then the fire went out. Come closer. There is more to tell, and not much time to tell it.
